## Highlights
### Improved
- Sidebar preview cards and the lists fan now start at 80% of their size and grow the rest of the way as they fade in, instead of growing out of a point. Buttons and controls that appear in place, such as the reset buttons and the gradient controls in the color picker, grow by the same amount. - iCloud sync status and the archive list use Crest's own colours: work under way in Crest blue, up to date in green, waiting on you in amber, and trouble or deleted tabs in red, while tabs you closed read quietly. - Saved passwords and Space choices in Settings show each Space in its own accent colour. - In the command palette, the Pinned & Saved search and the rows for pinned, saved and open tabs wear the same filled symbols as their sections in the sidebar. - Translation, the emoji picker, the viewport preview and the sidebar width preview use Crest blue instead of the Mac's system accent colour. - The downloads badge, and on iPhone and iPad the private browsing button, take the Space's accent colour, so they stand out from the sidebar behind them. - The sample page in the zoom and appearance settings is ink on Crest's warm paper, and the globe engine mark on tabs and in the site engine menu is Crest blue. - Extension badges are Crest's red with slightly larger text, and pinned extension buttons use the same hover highlight as Crest's other toolbar buttons.
---

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
